conflicts_and_limits: Repeated checklist occurrences preserved separately from explanatory design prose.
Provider incident feeds do not prove local dependency failure.
Offline provenance cannot establish later revocation status or release approval.
Recovery access and deployment require applicable explicit approval; source guidance does not grant it.
No viability evidence is invented; source explicitly requires a successful exercise.
Execution continuity is distinct from source, application, data and provider recovery.
